stories.title: Ring Video Doorbell Pro review: night and day better with new 4K camera
stories.summary: Ring’s top-end Video Doorbell Pro 3 adds a 4K camera, improved Wi-Fi and new AI features in both wired and battery versions. The review also notes a sleeker design that retains Ring’s familiar two-tone look, button, logo and ringtone.

stories.title: UK to force Apple and Google to block explicit images on children’s smartphones
stories.summary: The UK government says it will legislate to make Apple and Google block explicit images on children’s smartphones after talks with the companies failed to produce an agreement. The move puts ministers at odds with the technology groups and follows the government’s announcement of a social-media ban for children under 16.

links.headline: UK to force Apple and Google to block explicit images on children’s smartphones

stories.title: Lawmakers blast AI companies after researcher warns of human extinction by 2030
stories.summary: Lawmakers criticised AI companies after researchers associated with Anthropic warned that artificial intelligence could cause human extinction by 2030 without regulation. Three researchers issued the warning, and one reportedly resigned in protest over the risks.
